material.description: scripts/dev/serve.mjs:19-33 and scripts/perf/first-draw.mjs:23. Symptom: types differ between the two and fall to octet-stream, so local behaviour differs from Pages (lua and glsl read fine only by luck of fetch().text()). Acceptance: one shared mime module imported by both, covering every extension under js/client and scenarios. Witness: curl -I of a .glsl and .ogg on the dev server.
material.subject: serve.mjs and first-draw.mjs keep separate MIME tables and neither covers .osdt .lua .tsv .glsl .ogg .svg
